picture-pairs.name: Zithunzi zofanana
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Kufananiza kwa Akulu: Jozi za Picha
picture-pairs.h1: Zithunzi Zofanana: Masewera Odekha Olinganiza Zithunzi
picture-pairs.description: Mchezo wa kufananiza wa bure na wa upole kwa watu wazima na wazee, wakiwemo watu wanaoishi na dementia. Picha zinaweza kubaki zikionekana. Hakuna kipima muda wala alama.
picture-pairs.short: Pezani zithunzi ziwiri zofanana. Zithunzi zitha kungokhalabe zooneka.
picture-pairs.intro: Khudzani chithunzi chimodzi, kenako khudzani china chofanana nacho. Zithunzi zimakhala zooneka nthawi zonse, motero sipafunika kukumbukira chilichonse. Zithunzi ziwiri zikafanana, pakhala mzere wa golide m'mbali pamodzi ndi chizindikiro chovomereza.
howTo: Sankhani kuchuluka kwa zithunzi zimene mukufuna kugwiritsa ntchito. Zithunzi zinayi ndi malo abwino komanso odekha oyambira.
Khudzani chithunzi chilichonse. Chikhala ndi mzere wa golide m'mbali.
Khudzani chithunzi china chofanana nacho. Zithunzi zofananazo zizikhala pamodzi zokhala ndi chizindikiro chovomereza.
Ngati zithunzi ziwirizo zili zosiyana, palibe vuto lililonse. Khudzaninso nthawi ina iliyonse mukakhala okonzeka.
Yatsani "Zithunzi zobisika" pokhapokha ngati nonsenu mumakonda mtundu wodziwika bwino wozondotsa zithunzi pansi.
tips: Tchulani mayina a zithunzizo mofuula limodzi ndikukambirana za izo: "Kapu yofiira ya tiyi. Kodi mumathira mkaka mu tiyi mwanu?"
Lolani munthu amene mukumusamalira kuti azikhudza yekha, ngakhale zitenga kanthawi. Mungomuloza m'malo momukhudzira.
Pitirizani ndi zithunzi zinayi bola ngati zikukusangalatsani. Kuonjezera zithunzi ndi kusankha kwanu, sikuti ndi gawo limene mukuyenera kukwaniritsa.
Malizani pamene mukusangalalabe. Masewera amodzi okha ndi ntchito yokwanira bwino.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena masikoro?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: N'chifukwa chiyani zithunzi zimakhalabe zooneka?
faq.a: Kusiya zithunzi zikuoneka kumachititsa masewerawa kukhala oyang'ana ndi kulinganiza m'malo mokumbukira. Anthu ambiri amaona kuti izi zimakhala zodekha kwambiri. Mutha kusintha kuti zithunzi zizibisika pakungokhudza kamodzi ngati mukufuna.

faq.q: Kodi ndi zaulere, nanga ndikufunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi zaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Zimagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

faq.q: Kodi tingathe kugwiritsa ntchito zithunzi za banja lathu?
faq.a: Inde. Yesani Photo pairs, zomwe zimakulolani kusankha zithunzi kuchokera pa chipangizo chanu. Zithunzizo zimakhalabe mu msakatuli mwanu ndipo sizitumizidwa kwina kuli konse.

find-the-same.name: Pezani chofanana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Pata Picha Inayofanana: Mchezo Rahisi wa Picha
find-the-same.description: Picha moja juu, mbili hadi nne chini. Gusa inayofanana. Mchezo wa picha wa bure na wa utulivu kwa watu wazima, wazee na familia, bila kipima muda.
find-the-same.short: Yang'anani chithunzi chapamwamba ndikukhudza chofanana nacho pansi.
find-the-same.intro: Chithunzi chimodzi chimakhala pamwamba pa sikirini. Pansi pake pamakhala zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi. Khudzani chithunzi chimene chili chofanana. Ndi kusankha kumodzi kosavuta pa nthawi imodzi, kukhala ndi mwayi wokwanira wocheza.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zoti musankhepo. Ziwiri ndiye zosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anirani limodzi chithunzi chapamwamba.
Khudzani chithunzi chofanana nacho pansi. Chimayikidwa chizindikiro chovomereza pamodzi ndi mawu ochepa ofunda.
Ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi chosiyana, masewerawa amangotchula dzina lake ndikudikirira. Tengani nthawi yanu.
Khudzani "Chithunzi chotsatira" mukakhala okonzeka kupita pa china.
tips: Kambiranani za chithunzi chilichonse musanasankhe: mitundu, maonekedwe, kapena komwe mungachione.
Zosankha ziwiri sizitanthauza kuti ndi "zosavuta mopitirira". Cholinga ndi kukhala ndi nthawi yosangalatsa, osati mayeso.
Ngati kukhudza kuli kovuta, munthuyo akhoza kuloza ndipo inu n'kumukhudzira.

faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi chimachitika n'chiyani ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi cholakwika?
faq.a: Palibe chosasangalatsa chilichonse. Palibe phokoso lochenjeza, mtanda wofiira kapena kugwedezeka. Masewerawa amangotchula chithunzi chimene chakhudzidwacho ndikudikirira kukhudzidwanso kwina.

faq.q: Kodi ndi zaulere, nanga ndikufunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi zaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Zimagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

shadow-match.name: Kufananiza mthunzi
shadow-match.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Kulinganisha Vivuli: Bure Mtandaoni kwa Watu Wazima
shadow-match.h1: Kufananiza Mthunzi: Masewera Odekha a Zithunzi
shadow-match.description: Kivuli cheusi juu, picha mbili hadi nne chini. Gusa picha inayotengeneza kivuli hicho. Mchezo wa bure, wa utulivu wa kulinganisha vivuli, bila kipima muda.
shadow-match.short: Yang'anani mthunziwo ndikukhudza chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo.
shadow-match.intro: Kufananiza mthunzi ndi ntchito yodziwika bwino yopezeka pamapepala osindikiza, koma pano pali zithunzi zazikulu ndipo palibe chosindikiza. Mthunzi wooneka bwino umakhala pamwamba pa sikirini ndipo zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zimakhala pansi. Khudzani chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo. Zinthu monga njinga, ambulera kapena kapu ya tiyi n'zosavuta kukambirananso.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri, zitatu kapena zinayi zoti musankhepo. Ziwiri ndiye zosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anirani limodzi mthunziwo. Ndi wooneka bwanji? Ndi woutali kapena wozungulira?
Khudzani chithunzi chimene chikupanga mthunziwo. Dzina lake lidzaonekera pansi pa mthunziwo.
Ngati chakhudzidwa chithunzi chosiyana, masewerawa amangotchula dzina lake ndikudikirira. Tengani nthawi yanu.
Khudzani "Mthunzi wotsatira" mukakhala okonzeka kupita pa wina.
tips: Tsatani m'mbali mwa mthunziwo ndi chala ndikukambirana mmene ulili.
Ngati mithunzi ikuoneka yovuta lero, sinthani n'kupita pa Pezani chofanana, komwe zithunzi zake zimakhala zofanana.
Kambiranani za chithunzicho chikapezeka: "Tinalinso ndi ambulera yotere."

faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, masikoro, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kulephera. Mutha kusiya nthawi ina iliyonse, ndipo kusiya pakati ndi njira yabwino kwambiri yomalizira.

faq.q: Je, watu wanaoishi na dementia wanaweza kufurahia kulinganisha vivuli?
faq.a: Watu wazima wengi hufurahia, wakiwemo baadhi ya watu wanaoishi na dementia, mara nyingi katika hatua za mwanzo. Maumbo ni rahisi kutambua kuliko maneno. Ni kwa ajili ya furaha na mazungumzo, si mtihani, na haitibu wala kupunguza kasi ya dementia. Kama inaleta kufadhaika, jaribu Pata inayofanana au tazama picha pamoja tu.

faq.q: Nanga chimachitika chiyani ngati wina wasindikiza chithunzi cholakwika?
faq.a: Palibe chosasangalatsa. Palibe phokoso, chizindikiro chofiira kapena kugwedezeka. Masewerawa amatchula chithunzi chimene chasindikizidwa ndipo amadikira kusindikiza kotsatira.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa chilichonse. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta.

four-together.name: Wanne pamoja
four-together.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Kupanga Picha kwa Watu Wazima: Wanne Pamoja
four-together.h1: Wanne Pamoja: Mchezo wa Utulivu wa Kupanga Picha
four-together.description: Baadhi ya picha zina mada moja, kama matunda au hali ya hewa. Gusa zile zinazoendana. Mchezo wa bure wa kupanga, wa utulivu, bila kipima muda wala alama.
four-together.short: Tafuta picha zinazoendana, kama matunda au hali ya hewa.
four-together.intro: Seti ndogo ya picha, na baadhi yake ni za pamoja: labda aina nne za matunda, au njia nne za kusafiri. Gusa zile zinazoshiriki mada moja. Ikiwa picha inaendana na kitu kingine, mchezo unaitaja tu na kusubiri. Baada ya kimya kifupi, kidokezo kinataja mada, na "Onyesha kundi" hufichua jibu wakati wowote.
howTo: Chagua picha nne, sita au nane. Nne ndiyo rahisi zaidi, zikiwa tatu zinazoendana.
Angalieni picha pamoja na zungumzieni zinafanana nini.
Gusa kila picha inayoingia kwenye kundi. Itapata mpaka wa dhahabu na alama ya tiki.
Ikiwa picha inaendana na nyingine, mchezo unasema hivyo na kusubiri. Chukua muda wako.
Gusa "Onyesha kundi" wakati wowote unapotaka, kisha "Seti nyingine" kwa picha mpya.
tips: Sema kwa sauti unachokiona: "Hizi mbili zote ni vitu vya kula."
Hakuna haraka. Kidokezo kinachotaja mada hutokea baada ya kimya, na unaweza kukipuuza.
Zungumzieni kundi likishapatikana: tunda mnalopenda, safari ya treni, hali ya hewa ya leo.

faq.q: Je, kuna kipima muda au alama?
faq.a: Hapana. Hakuna saa, alama, kaunta ya hatua wala kushindwa. Unaweza kusimama wakati wowote, na kusimama katikati ni njia nzuri kabisa ya kumaliza.

faq.q: Nini kinatokea picha isiyo ya kundi ikigusiwa?
faq.a: Hakuna jambo baya. Hakuna kengele, msalaba mwekundu wala mtikisiko. Mchezo unataja picha, unasema inaendana na kitu kingine, kisha unasubiri gusa lijalo.

faq.q: Makundi ni yapi?
faq.a: Mada za kila siku zisizohitaji ujuzi maalum: matunda, wanyama, maua, hali ya hewa, njia za kusafiri, vitu vya kunywa kinywaji cha moto na vitu vilivyookwa kwenye oveni. Kila picha ni ya kundi moja tu.

faq.q: Je, ni bure, na ninahitaji kujisajili?
faq.a: Ndiyo, ni bure, na hakuna akaunti, usajili wala upakuaji. Hufanya kazi kwenye kivinjari cha wavuti kwenye simu, kompyuta kibao au kompyuta.

odd-one-out.seoTitle: Mchezo wa Picha wa Isiyoendana kwa Watu Wazima

color-match.name: Kufanana kwa mitundu
color-match.seoTitle: Kufanana kwa Mitundu: Masewera Ofatsa a Zithunzi
color-match.h1: Kufanana kwa Mitundu: Pezani Zithunzi za Mtundu Umodzi
color-match.description: Mtundu waukulu ndi dzina lake, ndi zithunzi zinayi kapena zisanu ndi chimodzi. Dinani chithunzi chilichonse chomwe chili mtundu umenewo. Palibe wotchi, palibe mfundo, ndipo mtundu wina umangotchulidwa dzina lake. Ndi waulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
color-match.short: Pezani zithunzi zonse zomwe zili mtundu wofanana ndi wosonyezedwawo.
color-match.players: Anthu 1 kapena 2, kapena wamkulu ndi mwana
color-match.intro: Chigamba chachikulu cha mtundu chikuonetsedwa ndi dzina lake pambali pake, ndipo pansipa pali zithunzi zinayi kapena zisanu ndi chimodzi. Dinani chithunzi chilichonse chomwe chili mtundu umenewo, mwachitsanzo apulo wofiira ndi kapu yofiira. Ngati chithunzi chili mtundu wina, masewerawo amangotchula dzina lake (“Peyala ndi yobiriwira.”) ndipo amadikira. “Aonetseni” amasonyeza zithunzi zofanana nthawi iliyonse, ndipo “Mtundu wina” amapita patsogolo.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi zinayi kapena zisanu ndi chimodzi. Zinayi ndizosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anani mtunduwo ndipo werengani dzina lake pamodzi.
Dinani chithunzi chilichonse chomwe chili mtundu umenewo. Chilichonse chimapeza malire okhuthala ndi chizindikiro cha tiki.
Ngati chithunzi chili mtundu wina, masewerawo amanena kuti ndi mtundu wanji ndipo amadikira. Tengani nthawi yanu.
Dinani “Aonetseni” nthawi iliyonse mukafuna, kenako “Mtundu wina” kuti muone mtundu watsopano.
tips: Lankhulani mtunduwo mokweza, kenako yang'anani mozungulira chipinda: ndi zinthu zina ziti zomwe zili mtundu umenewo?
Gwiritsani ntchito mawu anu ngati mukufuna. “Phwetekere” kapena “thambo” ndi zabwino monga “wofiira” kapena “wabuluu”.
Kuloza kumagwira ntchito monga kudina. Khalani mbali imodzi kuti nonse muone chophimba.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Chimachitika chiyani ngati dinani chithunzi cha mtundu wina?
faq.a: Palibe chinthu chosasangalatsa. Palibe phokoso lolira, mtanda wofiira kapena kunjenjemera. Masewerawo amatchula chithunzicho ndi mtundu wake, monga “Peyala ndi yobiriwira.”, ndipo amadikira kudina kotsatira.

faq.q: Kodi mtundu ndiwo chizindikiro chokha?
faq.a: Ayi. Mtunduwo umaonetsedwa ngati chigamba chachikulu komanso wolembedwa ngati mawu, ndipo chithunzi chilichonse chimatchulidwa dzina lake chikadinidwa. Munthu amene amavutika kuona mtundu angathebe kusewera powerenga dzinalo.

faq.q: Kodi chithunzi chilichonse ndi mtundu umenewo ndithudi?
faq.a: Zithunzi zimasankhidwa ndi manja, ndipo ndi zokha zomwe chinthu chachikulu chili mtundu umodzi wokha. Zithunzi zokhala ndi mitundu yambiri, monga kaiti kapena njuchi, zimasiyidwa.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Inde. Pepala limodzi lili ndi mizere inayi. Mzere uliwonse umatchula mtundu ndipo umaonetsa zithunzi zinayi zoti muloze kapena kuzungulira.

faq.a: Inde, ndi yaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

halves-match.name: Kufanana kwa theka
halves-match.seoTitle: Kufanana kwa Theka: Masewera Ofatsa a Zithunzi
halves-match.h1: Kufanana kwa Theka: Lumikizani Mbali Ziwiri za Chithunzi
halves-match.description: Mbali zakumanzere za zithunzi ziwiri kapena zitatu mbali imodzi, ndi mbali zakumanja mbali inayo. Dinani theka limodzi, kenako theka lomwe likugwirizana nalo. Palibe wotchi, palibe mfundo, ndipo mbali zosagwirizana zimangolekanitsidwa. Ndi waulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
halves-match.short: Dinani mbali ziwiri zomwe zikugwirizana kuti zipange chithunzi chimodzi.
halves-match.players: Anthu 1 kapena 2, kapena wamkulu ndi mwana
halves-match.intro: Chithunzi chilichonse chadulidwa pakati. Mbali zakumanzere za zithunzi ziwiri kapena zitatu zili mzere umodzi, ndipo mbali zakumanja, mu dongosolo losiyana, zili mzere winawo. Dinani mbali yakumanzere, kenako dinani mbali yakumanja yomwe ikugwirizana nayo, monga mphuno ya kettle ndi chogwirira chake. Mbali zogwirizana zimalumikizidwa kukhala chithunzi chimodzi chathunthu. Mbali zosagwirizana zimalekanitsidwanso, ndipo masewerawo amanena izi mofatsa. “Ndionetseni” amazilumikiza zonse.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi ziwiri kapena zitatu. Ziwiri ndizosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anani mbali zakumanzere pamodzi. Mukuganiza kuti chilichonse ndi mbali ya chiyani?
Dinani mbali yakumanzere, kenako dinani mbali yakumanja yomwe ikugwirizana nayo. Zimagwiranso ntchito mosinthana.
Mbali zogwirizana zimalumikizidwa, ndi malire okhuthala ndi chizindikiro cha tiki. Mbali zosagwirizana zimalekanitsidwanso, ndipo mungayesenso ina.
Dinani “Ndionetseni” nthawi iliyonse mukafuna, kenako “Seti ina” kuti muone zithunzi zatsopano.
tips: Tsatani m'mphepete mwa theka ndi chala. Kodi chithunzicho chimafika kuti pakatikati?
Fotokozani zomwe mukuona: “Chimenecho chili ndi chogwirira.” Sikofunikira kutchula chithunzi chilichonse.
Kuloza kumagwira ntchito monga kudina. Khalani mbali imodzi kuti nonse muone chophimba.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kuwerengera mayendedwe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Chimachitika chiyani ngati mbali ziwiri sizigwirizana?
faq.a: Palibe chinthu chosasangalatsa. Palibe phokoso lolira, mtanda wofiira kapena kunjenjemera. Mbali ziwirizo zimalekanitsidwanso ndipo masewerawo amati, “Ziwirizi sizigwirizana. Yesani ina.” Palibe chimene chimawerengedwa.

faq.q: Kodi zithunzi ndi zosavuta kusiyanitsa?
faq.a: Inde. Zithunzi zimasankhidwa ndi manja, ndipo zithunzi ziwiri pa bolodi limodzi sizichokera ku gulu limodzi, monga zipatso ziwiri kapena nyama ziwiri. Zithunzi zomwe mbali zake ziwiri zimafanana, monga dzuwa kapena utawaleza, zimasiyidwa.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Ee. Pa pepala limodzi pali theka lakumanzere la zithunzi zitatu mu mzere umodzi, ndipo theka lakumanja lawo, mu dongosolo lina, mu mzere winawo. Jambulani mzere kuchokera ku theka lililonse lakumanzere kupita ku theka lomwe likugwirizana nalo.

color-by-number.name: Kupaka mtundu ndi nambala
color-by-number.seoTitle: Kupaka Mtundu ndi Nambala: Masewera Odekha a Kudzaza Ndi Malemba Akulu
color-by-number.h1: Kupaka Mtundu ndi Nambala: Dzazani Masikweya, Mtundu Uliwonse Umene Mukufuna
color-by-number.description: Gridi ya masikweya akulu okhala ndi manambala, ndi chizindikiro cha mitundu inayi ndi mayina awo. Sankhani mtundu, kenako dinani masikweya kuti muwadzaze. Mtundu uliwonse ndi wabwino, palibe wotchi kapena mfundo, ndipo batani limadzaza zotsalazo potsatira manambala. Ndi kwaulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
color-by-number.short: Sankhani mtundu, kenako dinani masikweya okhala ndi manambala kuti muwadzaze.
color-by-number.intro: Gridi ya masikweya akulu, lililonse lili ndi nambala, ndipo pamwamba pake pali chizindikiro cha mitundu inayi, lililonse lili ndi nambala yake ndi dzina lake lolembedwa. Sankhani mtundu pa chizindikiro, kenako dinani masikweya kuti muwadzaze. Gridi imayamba pa 4 ndi 4, ndipo ikhoza kukhala 6 ndi 6 kapena 8 ndi 8 ngati mukufuna masikweya ambiri. Masikweya onse akakhala ndi mtundu wa nambala yawo, gridi ndiye chithunzi cha pepalalo. Masikweya odzazidwa ndi mtundu wina uliwonse ndi chithunzi chanu chokha, ndipo masewerawa sanena kanthu pa izo. "Dzazani ndi manambala" imadzaza masikweya onse opanda kanthu m'malo mwanu.
howTo: Sankhani kukula kwa gridi. 4 ndi 4 ili ndi masikweya akulu kwambiri ndipo ndi yosavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anani chizindikiro chomwe chili pamwamba pa gridi. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi nambala ndi dzina, monga 1 Yellow.
Dinani mtundu pa chizindikiro, kenako dinani masikweya omwe mungafune kuwadzaza nawo.
Gwiritsani ntchito mtundu wa pa nambalayo, kapena mtundu uliwonse womwe mukufuna. Zonse ziwiri ndi zabwino.
Dinani "Dzazani ndi manambala" kwa masikweya opanda kanthu, "Chotsani" kuyambanso gridi, kapena "Chithunzi china" kuti mupeze china.
tips: Khalani moyandikana ndipo tengani nthawi mmodzimmodzi: munthu mmodzi asankhe mtundu, winayo adine masikweya.
Lankhulani za mitundu: "Ndimakonda zobiriwira." Sikofunikira kutchula chithunzi chidzakhala chiyani.
Pa skirini yopapatiza, gridi ya 8 ndi 8 imayenda kumbali mkati mwa bokosi lake lomwe. Masikweya amakhalabe ndi kukula kosavuta.
Mtundu wa pepala umagwiranso ntchito ndi mapensulo pa tebulo la pafupi ndi bedi.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya masitepe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Nanga ndikagwiritsa ntchito mtundu wosiyana ndi nambala?
faq.a: Palibe chimachitika, ndipo ndiko kudzakhala mfundoyo. Mtundu uliwonse ukhoza kukhala m'masikweya aliwonse, ndipo masewerawa sanena kanthu pa izo. Masikweya onse akakhala ndi mtundu wa nambala yawo, masewerawa amanena izi mofatsa, ndipo chithunzi cha mitundu yanu ndi chabwino chimodzimodzi.

faq.q: Kodi anthu osaona bwino mitundu angasiyanitse mitundu inayi?
faq.a: Idasankhidwa kuti ikhale choncho. Mtundu uliwonse ulinso ndi nambala, dzina lolembedwa ndi mawonekedwe ake ang'onoang'ono, choncho mtundu sichinthu chokha chosiyanitsira. Mitundu inayi idayesedwa ndi zoyeserera za kusaona bwino kwa mitundu yofiira-yobiriwira ndi yabuluu-yachikasu, ndipo imasiyananso ndi kuwala kwake. Munthu wosaona bwino mitundu sanayesebe, choncho chonde tidziwitseni ngati mitundu iwiri ikuoneka yofanana.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Inde. Pepala limodzi lili ndi gridi yokhala ndi manambala, ndi chizindikiro cha mitundu inayi ndi mayina awo. Pakani sikweya iliyonse ndi pensulo ya mtundu wa nambala yake, kapena mtundu uliwonse womwe mukufuna.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Ee, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

pattern-maker.name: Wopanga mapangidwe
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Wopanga Mapangidwe: Pangani Tile ndi Kusindikiza Mapangidwe
pattern-maker.h1: Wopanga Mapangidwe: Pangani Tile, Onani Ikubwerezedwa
pattern-maker.description: Sinthani masikweya a tile yaing'ono ndipo onani momwe ikubwerezedwera kukhala mapangidwe pambali pake, mu mitundu inayi yomwe ili ndi dzina ndi mawonekedwe ake. Palibe wotchi kapena mfundo. Ndi kwaulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
pattern-maker.short: Sinthani masikweya a tile yaing'ono ndipo onani momwe ikubwerezedwera kukhala mapangidwe.
pattern-maker.intro: Tile yaing'ono ya masikweya 3 ndi 3, kapena 4 ndi 4 ngati mukufuna, ndipo pambali pake pali "mapangidwe anu": tile yomweyo yobwerezedwa mu block. Dinani sikweya ndipo imasintha kukhala mtundu wotsatira mwa mitundu inayi, lililonse ndi dzina ndi mawonekedwe ake olembedwa. Mapangidwe ali pambali amasinthanso nthawi yomweyo. Palibe mapangidwe olondola, ndipo palibe chimene chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa. "Sindikizani mapangidwe anga" imayika mapangidwe obwerezedwa pa pepala limodzi kuti musunge, kupaka mtundu kapena kupereka.
howTo: Yang'anani tile ndi mapangidwe anu ali pambali pake. Ndi tile yomweyo, yobwerezedwa.
Dinani sikweya. Imasintha kukhala mtundu wotsatira mu mzere wa mitundu inayi pamwamba pake.
Pitirizani kudina masikweya mpaka mapangidwewo akhale monga momwe mukufunira. Mapangidwe aliwonse ndi abwino.
Dinani "Ndidabwitseni" kuti mupeze tile yatsopano, kapena "Yambaninso" kuti muyambe ndi yoyera. "Bwezerani" imabweretsa tile yomwe munali nayo.
Dinani "Sindikizani mapangidwe anga" ngati mukufuna pa pepala, kapena dinani Pumulani kuti muyime.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Kodi pali nthawi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, chiwerengero cha masitepe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuleka nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuleka pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi chilichonse chimene ndapanga chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa?
faq.a: Ayi. Chithunzi chanu chimakhala pa tsamba ili lokha. Sichisungidwa, sichikwezedwa kapena kuwerengedwa, ndipo chimazimirira tsamba likatsekedwa. Ngati mukufuna kusunga pateni, isindikizeni.

faq.q: Nanga ngati mungasankhe bokosi lolakwika kapena kufufuta chithunzicho mwangozi?
faq.a: Palibe bokosi lolakwika: dinani kachiwiri kuti mupite ku mtundu wotsatira. Mutakanikiza "Yambaninso" kapena "Ndidabwitseni", "Bweretsani" imabweza chithunzi chomwe munali nacho.

faq.q: Kodi anthu osaona mitundu bwino angathe kusiyanitsa mitundu inayi?
faq.a: Zinasankhidwa kuti zitheke. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi dzina lolembedwa komanso mawonekedwe ake ang'onoang'ono m'bokosi lililonse, kotero mtundu sikokha njira yodziwira kusiyana kwake. Mitundu inayi inayesedwa ndi masimulesheni a kusaona bwino kwa mitundu yofiira-yobiriwira ndi yabuluu-yachikasu. Munthu wosaona bwino mitundu sanayesepo, choncho chonde tidziwitseni ngati ziwiri zikuoneka zofanana.

faq.a: Bokosi lililonse ndi osachepera ma pikiseli 56 m'lifupi. Ngati chithunzicho ndi chachikulu kwambiri pa chophimba, chimayenda kumbali mkati mwa bokosi lake m'malo mochepetsa mabokosi.

faq.q: Kodi pali baibulo la pepala?
faq.a: Inde. "Sindikizani pateni yanga" imasindikiza pateni yomwe mwapanga pa tsamba limodzi, ndi mitundu inayi ndi mayina awo, yoonekera bwino pa zakuda ndi zoyera chifukwa mtundu uliwonse uli ndi mawonekedwe ake.

drawing-duet.seoTitle: Kujambula Awiri: Anthu Awiri, Chithunzi Chimodzi
drawing-duet.h1: Kujambula Awiri: Anthu Awiri, Pepala Limodzi
drawing-duet.description: Anthu awiri amatenga nthawi kujambula mizere pa chinsalu chimodzi chogawana, aliyense ndi mtundu wake. Palibe amene amapeza mfundo kapena kupambana, ndipo chithunzicho chikhoza kusungidwa kapena kusindikizidwa. Ndi kwaulere kusewera, popanda akaunti.
drawing-duet.short: Tengani nthawi kujambula chithunzi chimodzi chogawana ndi munthu wakhala naye pafupi.
drawing-duet.intro: Chinsalu chimodzi, anthu awiri. Aliyense wa inu asankha mtundu, ndipo mtundu uliwonse uli ndi dzina lake lolembedwa. Mumatenga nthawi: jambulani mzere umodzi kapena chithunzi chimodzi, kenako perekani cholembera. Aliyense wa inu akhoza kupereka nthawi iliyonse. Palibe chithunzi cholondola ndipo palibe mfundo. Sungani chithunzicho pa chipangizo chanu ngati mukuchikonda, kapena sindikizani baibulo la pepala: pepala limodzi, zolembera ziwiri.
howTo: Aliyense wa inu asankhe mtundu. Bokosi la mutu likuonetsa yemwe ali ndi nthawi, ndi mtundu wa munthuyo ndi dzina lake.
Jambulani mzere umodzi kapena chithunzi chimodzi ndi chala, mbewa kapena cholembera. Kapena gwiritsani ntchito makiyi a mivi ndi Space kujambula popanda pointer.
Mukakonzeka, dinani "Perekani cholembera". Aliyense wa inu akhoza kupereka nthawi iliyonse.
Dinani "Chotsani mzere wanga womaliza" kuti muchotse mzere waposachedwa kwambiri wa munthu yemwe ali ndi nthawi.
Dinani "Sungani chithunzi" kuti mupange fayilo ya chithunzi pa chipangizo chino, kapena "Sindikizani baibulo la pepala" la pepala limodzi ndi zolembera ziwiri.

Yambani ndi kadontho, mzere kapena chithunzi chosavuta, ndipo lolani munthu winayo ayankhe.
Palibe amene ayenera kujambula chinthu chilichonse. Pateni ya mizere ndi yabwino mofanana ndi chithunzi cha malo.
Ngati mukufuna kuleka, dinani "Zatha pakali pano". Chithunzi chanu sichisungidwa mukachoka pa tsambali pokhapokha mutachisunga.

faq.a: Ayi, palibe chimene chimatumizidwa kulikonse. Chithunzicho chimakhala pa tsambali mpaka mutatseka. Ngati mukanikiza Sungani chithunzi, fayilo imapangidwa pa chipangizo chanu kuti mutsitse. Palibe chimene chimakwezedwa.

seated-toss.name: Kuwerenga kuponya pansi
seated-toss.seoTitle: Kuwerenga Kuponya Pansi: Masewera a Thumba la Nyemba kwa Awiri
seated-toss.h1: Kuwerenga Kuponya Pansi: Ponyani Pamodzi Patebulo
seated-toss.description: Anthu awiri patebulo amatenga nthawi kuponya thumba lofewa la nyemba mu chandamale chachikulu ndipo amasunga kuwerenga pa pepala. Palibe chimene chimayezedwa kapena kupatsidwa mfundo. Ndi waulere kusindikiza.
seated-toss.short: Tengani nthawi kuponya thumba la nyemba mu chandamale chachikulu, ndi kuwerenga pa pepala.
seated-toss.intro: Masewera odekha oponyera a anthu awiri okhala patebulo. Mumaika chandamale chosindikizidwa patebulo ndipo mumatenga nthawi kuponya thumba lofewa la nyemba, kapena sokisi yokulungidwa, kuti ligwere mu mphete. Aliyense wa inu amasunga kuwerenga poika chizindikiro m'mabokosi pa pepala, ndipo mukayima mumayang'ana zizindikirozo pamodzi. Palibe chimene chimayezedwa, palibe chimene chimawerengedwa pa chinsalu, ndipo palibe chimene chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa. Chonde werengani choyamba malangizo achitetezo: zodzaza zing'onozing'ono zingayambitse kutsamwa.
howTo: Werengani malangizo achitetezo. Sankhani thumba lokhala ndi chivundikiro cholukidwa, kapena kulungani sokisi yoyera.
Dinani "Sindikizani chandamale ndi pepala lowerengera" ndipo ikani pepalalo pansi patebulo pakati panu.
Khalani bwino, aliyense mbali imodzi, ndipo tengani nthawi kuponya kamodzi mofatsa. Aliyense akhoza kudumpha.
Ponyo likagwera mu mphete, ikani chizindikiro m'bokosi la mzere wanu, pa mzere wa mphete imeneyo.
Muyang'ane zizindikirozo pamodzi mukayima, kapena dinani Pumulani kuti muime kaye.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ndi kuponya kwanu kofewa." Everyone cheers for every toss.

faq.q: Kodi n'kotetezeka kuponya thumba la nyemba?

Gwiritsani ntchito thumba lolumikizidwa kapena sock yopindidwa, osati nyemba, mpunga kapena zinthu zing'onozing'ono zotayirira, zomwe zingatseke pakhosi kwa ana aang'ono ndi kwa aliyense amene amaika zinthu m'kamwa. Khalani pansi, ponyani mofewa kulunjika patebulo ndipo musaponyere kunkhope, ndipo khalani pafupi ndi munthu wamkulu.

faq.q: Kodi pali chilichonse chowerengedwa kapena kusungidwa pazenera?
faq.a: Ayi. Kuwerengera kumachitika papepala lokha, m'mabokosi amene inu nokha mumatsindika. Tsambali silisunga kauntala kapena wotchi, ndipo palibe chimene chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa.

faq.q: Nanga ngati wina sangathe kuponya, kapena thumba likugwera kunja kwa pepala?
faq.a: Aliyense akhoza kupereka mwayi wake, ndipo thumba lomwe lagwera kunja kwa pepala lingotengedwa kuti likhale la nthawi yotsatira. Palibe chimene chimawerengedwa chifukwa cha izo.

faq.q: Kodi pali chiyani papepala losindikizidwa?
faq.a: Tsamba limodzi: chandamale chachikulu chokhala ndi mphete zitatu zotchedwa Pafupi, Pakati ndi Patali, tebulo lokhala ndi mzere wa munthu aliyense ndi mizere ya mabokosi ang'onoang'ono oti mutsindike pa mphete iliyonse, ndi mzere wa malangizo a chitetezo. Maina alembedwa pa mphete, kotero zimagwira ntchito ngakhale mu zakuda ndi zoyera.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

seasonal-pack.name: Paketi ya masewera a nyengo
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Paketi ya Masewera a Nyengo: Masewera a Papepala Osindikizika
seasonal-pack.h1: Paketi ya Masewera a Nyengo: Masewera Atatu a Papepala a Nyengo Iliyonse
seasonal-pack.description: Masewera atatu ang'onoang'ono osindikizika a masika, chilimwe, autumn kapena nyengo yozizira: fananitsani awiriawiri, zungulirani chimene chili chosiyana, ndipo mtundani chithunzi. Sankhani nyengo, kapena tengani tsiku lopuma. Ndi waulere kusindikiza.
seasonal-pack.short: Masewera atatu osindikizika a nyengo imene mwasankha, kapena tsiku lopuma.
seasonal-pack.intro: Sankhani nyengo, ndipo tsambali likuwonetsa masewera atatu ang'onoang'ono a papepala ochokera ku zithunzi za nyengoyo: mizere iwiri yoti mulumikize ndi mizere, mzere wa anayi woti muzungulire chimene chili chosiyana, ndi chithunzi choti mutsitsimutse ndi mitundu. Mumasindikiza tsamba limodzi, kenako chitani limodzi, awiri kapena onse atatu, mwa liwiro lanu. Sankhani "Lero ndi tsiku lopuma" m'malo mwake, ndipo palibe chochita.
howTo: Sankhani nyengo, kapena sankhani "Lero ndi tsiku lopuma".
Yang'anani masewera atatu, kenako dinani "Sindikizani paketi ya nyengo iyi".
Chitani limodzi, awiri kapena onse atatu, mwa liwiro lanu.
Lumikizani zithunzi zofanana ndi mzere, zungulirani chimene chili chosiyana, ndipo mtundani chithunzi chachikulu.
Lekani liti lomwe mukufuna. Tsiku lopuma nalonso ndi tsiku labwino.
tips: Yambani ndi masewera omwe akuoneka osavuta lero. Imodzi ndi yokwanira.
Tchulani mokweza dzina la chithunzi chilichonse, ngati zikuthandizani.
Gwiritsani ntchito makrayoni kapena mapensulo. Mitundu iliyonse ndi yabwino.
Sungani tsamba la nthawi ina, kapena lekani kulipitiriza.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena chiwerengero cha mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya masitepe kapena kugonjetsedwa. Mungathe kuleka nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuleka pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi tsambali likudziwa kuti ndi nyengo yanji?
faq.a: Ayi. Inu ndinu amene musankha nyengo. Tsambali silifufuza tsiku kapena malo anu.

faq.q: Kodi pali mfundo kapena yankho lolondola?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe chimene chimayesedwa nthawi, chimawerengedwa mfundo kapena kuyang'aniridwa pazenera, ndipo palibe mayankho amene amaonetsedwa. Masewera aliwonse ndi chithunzi chongochiyang'ana, kuchilumikiza, kuchizungulira kapena kuchitsitsimutsa ndi mitundu.

faq.q: Nanga ngati palibe amene akufuna masewera lero?
faq.a: Sankhani "Lero ndi tsiku lopuma". Tsambali likuwonetsa mzere umodzi wodekha, ndipo palibe chosindikiza kapena chochita.

faq.q: Kodi pali chiyani papepala losindikizidwa?
faq.a: Tsamba limodzi la nyengo imene mwasankha: masewera ake atatu, aliyense ali ndi mzere waufupi wofotokoza momwe angachitikire, ndi mzere wonena kuti mungathe kuchita limodzi, awiri kapena onse atatu.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

decorate-a-card.name: Kukongoletsa khadi pamodzi
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Kukongoletsa Khadi Pamodzi: Khadi Lolonjera Losindikizika
decorate-a-card.h1: Kukongoletsa Khadi Pamodzi: Pangani Khadi la Munthu Winawake
decorate-a-card.description: Anthu awiri amakongoletsa khadi lolonjera losindikizika la tsiku lobadwa, kuthokoza kapena chifukwa chakuti basi, kenako amalemba uthenga kumbuyo pamodzi. Makrayoni kapena zolembera zokha. Palibe wotchi kapena mfundo. Ndi waulere kusindikiza.
decorate-a-card.intro: Masewera abata opanga pamodzi kwa anthu awiri okhala mbali ndi mbali. Mumasindikiza pepala limodzi, lomwe limapindika pakati kuti likhale khadi. Sankhani chochitika, monga tsiku lobadwa kapena kuthokoza, ndipo kongoletsani kutsogolo mozungulira mawu ake. Kenako lembani uthenga kumbuyo, pamodzi, kapena munthu m'modzi akulemba zomwe winayo akunena. Gwiritsani ntchito makrayoni, mapensulo amitundu kapena zolembera za nsonga yokhuthala. Palibe khadi lolondola, ndipo palibe chimene chimayesedwa nthawi, kuwerengedwa mfundo kapena kutumizidwa.
howTo: Chagulani la mwambo, kenako dinani "Sindikitsani khadi".
Pindani pepalali pakati pa mzere wa madontho, kuti kutsogolo kukhale kunja.
Munthu m'modzi akongoletse kutsogolo, winayo kumbuyo, kapena mukhoza kusinthana pa mbali imodzi.
Lembani uthenga pamodzi. Munthu m'modzi angalembe pamene winayo akunena mawuwo.
Siyani nthawi iliyonse mukafuna. Khadi losavuta ndi labwino mofanana ndi lovuta.
tips: Yambani ndi mawu a kutsogolo, kenako onjezani masamba, nyenyezi kapena madontho mozungulira mawuwo, chimodzi panthawi.
Ngati wina sakonda kujambula, akhoza kusankha mitundu kapena kulemba uthengawo.
Nenani zomwe mumakonda pa zizindikiro za mnzanu, osati ngati ndi zabwino kapena ayi.
Sungani khadi pamalo pomwe lingaperekedwe, kapena ingoliikani patebulo pakadali pano.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya mayendedwe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi tifunika guluu, lumo kapena masitikala?
faq.a: Ayi. Makrayoni, mapensulo amitundu kapena zolembera za nsonga zokwanira. Palibe chomwe chifunika kudulidwa, kumatidwa kapena kumamatidwa.

faq.q: Kodi tingapange khadi la chochitika chimene sichili pa mndandanda?
faq.a: Sankhani "Chifukwa chokha" ndipo lembani mawu anuanu kutsogolo, kapena ingokongoletsani khadilo popanda chochitika chilichonse.

faq.q: Kodi pali chilichonse chowerengedwa, kuweruzidwa kapena kusungidwa pa skrini?
faq.a: Ayi. Tsambali likungosonyeza khadi ndi masitepe. Palibe chomwe chimayikidwa mwadongosolo, kupatsidwa mfundo kapena kusungidwa, ndipo palibe khadi lolondola.

faq.q: Kodi n'chiyani chili pa pepala losindikizidwa?
faq.a: Tsamba limodzi: khadi lopindidwa pakati, ndi mawu a chochitikacho ndi chimango chosavuta kutsogolo, komanso mizere ya uthenga ndi ya "Kuchokera kwa" kumbuyo. Malamulo a anthu awiri asindikizidwa m'munsi.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndifunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi waulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

find-together.name: Pezani pamodzi
find-together.seoTitle: Pezani Pamodzi: Anthu Awiri Akupeza Maawiriwo
find-together.h1: Pezani Pamodzi: Anthu Awiri, Gulu Limodzi
find-together.description: Anthu awiri amagawana skrini imodzi ndipo amasinthana kutembenuza makhadi awiri a zithunzi kuti apeze awiri ofanana. Maawiri amapezeka pamodzi ndipo amawerengedwa pa kauntala imodzi yogawana. Ndi yaulere kusewera, popanda wotchi kapena mfundo.
find-together.short: Sinthanani ndi munthu amene ali pafupi nanu kuti mupeze maawiri a zithunzi.
find-together.intro: Makhadi amayamba ndi zithunzi zawo zikuoneka, kapena mukhoza kuwayika chinsalu chili pansi. Pa nthawi yanu, mumatembenuza makhadi awiri. Ngati ndi awiri ofanana, mwawapeza pamodzi ndipo nthawi ikupita kwa winayo. Ngati ndi osiyana, amakhalabe chinsalu chili pamwamba mpaka mutakanikiza "Wabwezeretseni", kuti nonse mukhoze kuwayang'ana. Mukhoza kupereka nthawi iliyonse. Kauntala ya pamwamba imangokwera: maawiri omwe mwapeza pamodzi.
howTo: Sankhani makhadi angati omwe mugwiritse ntchito. Makhadi asanu ndi limodzi, maawiri atatu, ndi malo abata oyambira.
Skrini imasonyeza yemwe ali ndi nthawi, ndi bwalo la munthu woyamba ndi lalikulu la munthu wachiwiri.
Tembenuzani makhadi awiri, imodzi pambuyo pa inzake. Ngati akufanana, awiriwo apezeka pamodzi.
Ngati ndi osiyana, kanikizani "Wabwezeretseni" mukakhala nonse okonzeka. Nthawi ndiye imapita kwa winayo.
Aliyense wa inu akhoza kukanikiza "Perekani" nthawi iliyonse. Dinani "Yambaninso" kuti mupeze makhadi atsopano, kapena dinani Pumulani kuti muyime.
tips: Khalani pambali pa mnzake ndipo tchulani zithunzizo mokweza pamodzi: "Kapu ya tiyi. Kodi mumakonda mkaka mu tiyi wanu?"
Lolani munthu amene mumamusamalira kukanikiza, ngakhale zitenge nthawi. Lozani m'malo mokanikizira m'malo mwake.
Sankhani "Makhadi chinsalu chili pansi" ngati nonse mumakonda kutembenuza makhadi kuti mupeze zithunzi.
Munthu amene atopa msanga akhoza kupereka nthawi zambiri momwe akufunira. Maawiri amapezekabe pamodzi.

faq.q: Kodi pali wopambana, wotchi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wopambana, chifukwa mumapeza maawiri monga gulu. Palibe wotchi, mfundo kapena kuwerengera kolakwika. Kauntalayo imangowerengera maawiri omwe mwapeza pamodzi, ndipo mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse.

faq.q: Kodi tifunika kukumbukira kumene zithunzi zili?
faq.a: Ayi. Masewerowa amayamba ndi zithunzi zonse zikuoneka. Ndi makhadi chinsalu chili pansi, mukhoza kufunsana zomwe munaona, kapena kungowatembenuzanso.

faq.q: Kodi chimachitika chiyani ngati makhadi awiri ndi osiyana?
faq.a: Amakhalabe chinsalu chili pamwamba, kuti nonse mukhoze kuwayang'ana nthawi yonse yomwe mukufuna. Palibe chimene chimawatembenuzanso chokha. Mukakonzeka, kanikizani "Wabwezeretseni" ndipo nthawi ipita kwa munthu winayo.

faq.q: Kodi chilichonse chimene timasewera chimasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa?
faq.a: Ayi. Makhadi amakhala patsamba lino lokha. Palibe chimene chimasungidwa, kukwezedwa kapena kuwerengedwa, ndipo chimatha mukatseka tsambalo.

faq.q: Kodi makhadi ndi aakulu mokwanira kwa munthu wagwedezeka dzanja kapena skrini yaing'ono?
faq.a: Khadi lililonse ndi lalikulu osachepera ma pikiseli 64 m'lifupi, ndipo ndi lalikulu momwe skrini imalolera. Ogwiritsa ntchito kiyibodi ndi owerenga skrini amamva khadi lililonse ndi malo ake ndi chithunzi chake.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndifunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi waulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

story-dice.name: Madayisi a nkhani
story-dice.seoTitle: Madayisi a Nkhani: Masewera a Kunena Nkhani ndi Zithunzi
story-dice.h1: Madayisi a Nkhani: Nenani Nkhani ndi Zithunzi
story-dice.description: Madayisi atatu kapena anayi a zithunzi oti munene nkhani nawo, mwa dongosolo lililonse. Palibe kuwerenga, palibe yankho lolondola, palibe wotchi ndi palibe mfundo. Ponyaninso, kapena perekani. Ndi yaulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
story-dice.short: Ponyani madayisi a zithunzi ndipo nenani nkhani pamodzi, mwa dongosolo lililonse.
story-dice.players: Anthu 2 kapena kuposerapo, kapena wamkulu ndi mwana
story-dice.intro: Zinthu zitatu kapena zinayi zimaonetsedwa, ngati madayisi. Pamodzi, pangani nkhani yogwiritsa ntchito zithunzizo, mwadongosolo lililonse. Nkhani ikhoza kukhala sentensi imodzi kapena zingapo, ndipo ikhoza kukhala yoseketsa kapena yofanana ndi moyo weniweni. Palibe nkhani yolondola, ndipo palibe amene ayenera kutchula kapena kukumbukira chilichonse. Dinani "Ponyani zina" kuti mupeze zithunzi zatsopano, ndipo aliyense akhoza kudumpha.
howTo: Sankhani madayisi atatu kapena anayi. Atatu ndi osavuta kwambiri.
Yang'anani zithunzizo pamodzi. Dinani imodzi ngati mukufuna kuyamba nayo.
Lankhulani mothandizana kufotokoza nkhani yogwiritsa ntchito zithunzizo, mwadongosolo lililonse. Sentensi imodzi iliyonse ndi yokwanira.
Aliyense akhoza kudumpha. Dinani "Dumphani" ndipo munthu wotsatira angayambe.
Dinani "Ponyani zina" kuti mupeze zithunzi zatsopano nthawi iliyonse, kapena dinani Pumulani kuti muleke.
tips: Funsani funso m'malo moyembekezera yankho: "Kodi ambulera ikupita kuti?"
Onjezerani pa zomwe munthu wapitayo ananena m'malo mowakonza. Nkhani iliyonse ndi yabwino.
Nkhani ikhoza kukhala za kukumbukira kweniweni. Chithunzi ndi chiyambi chabwino cha nkhani yotere.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mphambu?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mphambu, kuwerengera kwa masewero kapena kuluza. Mukhoza kuleka nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuleka pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi ndiyenera kuwerenga kapena kutchula zithunzi?
faq.a: Ayi. Masewerowa amagwira ntchito ndi zithunzi zokha. Osewera akhoza kuloza, kufotokoza, kapena kungonena zomwe chithunzicho chimawakumbutsa. Palibe amene akufunsidwa kutchula kapena kukumbukira chilichonse.

faq.q: Nanga bwanji ngati wina sakufuna kutenga nthawi yake?
faq.a: Akhoza kudumpha nthawi iliyonse popanda kufotokoza. Masewerawo amangodikira, ndipo munthu wotsatira akhoza kuyamba, kapena mukhoza kuponyanso.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Inde. Pepala limodzi lili ndi zithunzi khumi ndi zisanu ndi chimodzi zosiyana, mu mizere inayi. Sankhani mzere umodzi, kapena dulani zithunzizo ndi kujambula zina pamulu.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Mawu ndi zithunzi zofanana
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Mawu ndi Zithunzi Zofanana: Fananitsani Mawu ndi Zithunzi
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Mawu ndi Zithunzi Zofanana: Fananitsani Mawu ndi Chithunzi Chake
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Fananitsani mawu achingerezi ndi zithunzi zake, ndipo mvetserani mawu aliwonse akuwerengedwa mokweza. Zithunzi zimakhala pamaso panu, popanda wotchi, mphambu kapena kuwerengera mayesero. Ndi yaulere kusewera ndi kusindikiza.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Fananitsani mawu aliwonse ndi chithunzi chake, ndipo mvetserani akuwerengedwa mokweza.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Munthu mmodzi wamkulu, kapena banja likusewera pafupi
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Zithunzi zinayi kapena zisanu ndi chimodzi zimaonetsedwa, pamodzi ndi mawu awo achingerezi mu dongosolo losiyana. Dinani mawu kenako chithunzi chake, kapena chithunzi kenako mawu ake. Awiri ofanana amakhalabe pamodzi ndi malire okhuthala ndi mawu oti "Zafanana". Dinani "Werengani mokweza" pafupi ndi mawu aliwonse kuti mumve akuwerengedwa. Palibe nthawi kapena mphambu, ndipo dinani lomwe silifanana limangochotsedwa lokha.
howTo: Sankhani zithunzi zinayi kapena zisanu ndi chimodzi. Zinayi ndi zosavuta kwambiri.
Dinani mawu, kenako chithunzi chomwe chimatchula. Kapena dinani chithunzi choyamba, kenako mawu ake.
Awiri ofanana amakhalabe pamodzi. Dinani lomwe silifanana limachotsedwa mwakachetechete, kotero yesani wina.
Dinani "Werengani mokweza" pafupi ndi mawu kuti mumve, ngati chipangizo chanu chingawerenge mawu mokweza.
Dinani "Zithunzi zatsopano" kuti mupeze gulu lina, kapena "Yambaninso" kuti mulekanitse awiri onse. "Bweretsani" imabwezeretsa zofanana zomaliza.
tips: Werengani mawu aliwonse mokweza pamodzi musanawafanane, ndipo kambiranani za chithunzicho.
Mabanja akhoza kutenga nthawi mwakusinthana. Munthu aliyense asankhe mawu kapena chithunzi chimodzi panthawi.
Gwiritsani ntchito mawu omwe mukuwadziwa kale poyamba, ndipo siyani ena kuti mudzawagwiritse ntchito pambuyo pake.

faq.q: Kodi pali wotchi kapena mphambu?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mphambu, kuwerengera kwa masewero kapena kuluza. Mukhoza kuleka nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuleka pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi izi n'zakuti ana?
faq.a: Yapangidwira akuluakulu omwe akuphunzira kapena kubwezeretsa mawu achingerezi, komanso mabanja akusewera pafupi. Sinalembedwe ana.

faq.q: Nanga bwanji ngati chipangizo changa sichingawerenge mawu mokweza?
faq.a: Batani la Werengani mokweza limagwiritsa ntchito mawu omwe msakatuli wanu uli nawo kale. Ngati msakatuli sungayankhule, batani silionetsedwa ndipo masewerawo amagwira ntchito popanda izo.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Inde. Pepala limodzi lili ndi zithunzi zisanu ndi chimodzi ndi mawu ake asanu ndi limodzi, kuti muwadule kapena kuwagwirizanitsa ndi mzere.

faq.q: Kodi n'kwaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, n'kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito mu msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

sort-together.name: Konzani pamodzi
sort-together.seoTitle: Masewera Osankhira: Sankhani Pamodzi kwa Akuluakulu
sort-together.description: Dinani chithunzi, kenako dengu lake: khitchini kapena munda, zipatso kapena nyama. Masewera osankhira odekha komanso aulere kwa akuluakulu ndi mabanja.
sort-together.short: Ikani chithunzi chilichonse m'dengu lake: khitchini kapena munda, ndi zina.
sort-together.intro: Kukonza zinthu ndi ntchito yodziwika ya tsiku ndi tsiku yomwe imakondweretsa, monga kuika zinthu za kukhitchini kapena kufananiza masokisi. Sindikizani chithunzi, kenako sindikizani dengu limene chiyenera kukhala. Palibe chifukwa chothamangira, ndipo palibe njira yolakwika.
howTo: Sankhani mutu: khitchini ndi munda, zipatso ndi nyama, kapena kwathu ndi ulendo.
Sindikizani chithunzi. Chidzalandira malire agolide.
Sindikizani dengu limene chithunzicho chiyenera kukhala. Chidzalowa m'dengulo.
Ngati chiyenera kukhala m'dengu linalo, masewerawo adzanena izi modekha ndipo adzadikira.

collage-board.short: Ikani zithunzi pa bolodi limodzi, pang'onopang'ono.

Lolani anthu awiriwa kusankha chithunzi chodulidwa komanso malo, kuti aliyense akhale ndi mawu ake.

quiet-shapes.short: Lowetsani mawonekedwe osavuta mu chithunzi, pa liwiro lanu.
quiet-shapes.intro: Mzere wa chithunzi, monga nyumba, bwato kapena roketi, wagawidwa m'malo. Malo aliwonse ali ndi chidutswa cha mawonekedwe ofanana: katatu waukulu kapena waung'ono, lalikulu, paralelogramu kapena rectangle. Dinani chidutswa, kenako dinani malo a mawonekedwe ofanana, ndipo chidzalowa. Malowo amazungulira chidutswacho nokha, motero palibe chofunika kukokera kapena kuzungulira. story-chain.seoTitle: Unyolo wa Nkhani: Masewera a Nkhani ya Zithunzi Zogawana
story-chain.h1: Unyolo wa Nkhani: Fotokozani Nkhani Chithunzi Chimodzi Panthawi
story-chain.description: Mzere wa zithunzi umakula chimodzi panthawi, ndipo munthu aliyense amanena chiganizo chimodzi chokhudza icho mokweza. Palibe chofunika kulemba, palibe yankho lolondola. Ndi yaulere, yodekha, popanda nthawi kapena mfundo.
story-chain.short: Onjezani chithunzi, kenako aliyense anene chiganizo chimodzi, mosinthana.
story-chain.intro: Masewerawa amayamba ndi chithunzi chimodzi ndipo unyolo umakula chithunzi chimodzi panthawi. Munthu aliyense amanena chiganizo chimodzi chokhudza unyolo wakale mokweza, mosinthana. Chiganizo chingakhale chokhudza chimene mukuona, malo amene akukumbutsani, kapena chinthu choseketsa. Palibe chimene chimalembedwa, chojambulidwa kapena kusungidwa, palibe yankho lolondola, ndipo aliyense akhoza kudutsa. Unyolo umayima pa zithunzi eyiti, ndiyeno mukhoza kuyambitsa wina.
howTo: Yang'anani chithunzi choyamba pamodzi.
Mosinthana: munthu aliyense anene chiganizo chimodzi chokhudza unyolo wakale. Aliyense akhoza kudutsa.
Dinani "Onjezani chithunzi" kuti muike chithunzi chotsatira kumapeto kwa unyolo.
Dinani "Chotsani chomaliza" ngati mungakonde kubwerera chithunzi chimodzi.
Unyolo ukakhala ndi zithunzi eyiti, dinani "Yambitsani unyolo watsopano" kuti muyambe wina, kapena ingoyimani.
tips: Chiganizo chachifupi nʼchabwino: "Wina waika madzi pamoto." Munthu wotsatira apitirize, kapena adutse.
Lolani zithunzi zitsogolere. Palibe nkhani yomwe muyenera kufika.
Imani nthawi iliyonse mukafuna. Kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi pali nthawi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya mayendedwe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi chilichonse chimalembedwa kapena kujambulidwa?
faq.a: Ayi. Chiganizo chimanenedwa mokweza ndipo sichilembedwa, sichijambulidwa kapena kutumizidwa kulikonse. Masewerawa amangosonyeza zithunzi.

faq.q: Nanga bwanji ngati wina sakufuna kunena kanthu?
faq.a: Aliyense akhoza kudutsa, ndipo munthu wotsatira amapitirira. Palibe amene ayenera kutchula kapena kukumbukira chithunzi.

faq.q: Kodi n'zaulere, ndipo ndiyenera kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi yaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa webusaiti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

quiet-scene.name: Chithunzi chodekha
quiet-scene.h1: Chithunzi Chodekha: Chithunzi Chimodzi Chosasuntha Panthawi
quiet-scene.description: Chithunzi chimodzi chachikulu, chosasuntha panthawi, chilichonse chili ndi mzere umodzi wofatsa pansi pake. Dinani Yotsatira kapena Yapitayo mukakonzeka. Palibe chimasuntha kapena kuseweredwa chokha, ndipo palibe nthawi kapena mfundo. Ndi yaulere, popanda akaunti.
quiet-scene.short: Yang'anani chithunzi chimodzi chosasuntha panthawi, mwa liwiro lanu.
quiet-scene.intro: Chithunzi chimodzi chachikulu chimadzaza chophimba, ndi mzere waufupi pansi pake. Dinani "Chithunzi chotsatira" kapena "Chithunzi chapitacho" mukakonzeka kuona china. Palibe chimasuntha, kuzimiririka kapena kusintha chokha, ndipo palibe nthawi yoyezedwa. Dinani "Chithunzi chachikulu" kuti muwonetse chithunzicho chokha, kuti chipinda chonse chichione pa kanema wawayilesi.
howTo: Yang'anani chithunzichi pamodzi.
Werengani mzere womwe uli pansi pake mokweza ngati mukufuna.
Dinani "Chithunzi chotsatira" kapena "Chithunzi chapitacho" mukakonzeka.
Dinani "Chithunzi chachikulu" kuti muwonetse chithunzi chokha, ndi "Onetsani zonse" kuti zina zibwerere.
Imani nthawi iliyonse ndi "Tatha pakadali pano".
tips: Lolani munthuyo asankhe nthawi yopitira patsogolo: dikirani mpaka ayang'ane, kenako dinani Yotsatira.
Pa gulu, gwiritsani ntchito "Chithunzi chachikulu" pa kanema wawayilesi kapena chophimba chachikulu, ndipo khalani pomwe aliyense angachione.
Palibe njira yolondola yoyang'ana chithunzi. Kungolankhula za icho ndi ntchito yokwanira.

faq.q: Kodi pali nthawi kapena mfundo?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe wotchi, mfundo, kauntala ya mayendedwe kapena kutaya. Mukhoza kuyima nthawi iliyonse, ndipo kuyima pakati ndi njira yabwino yomalizira.

faq.q: Kodi imaseweretsa phokoso kapena kusuntha?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe phokoso, ndipo palibe chimasuntha, kuzimiririka kapena kusintha chokha. Chithunzi chimasintha pokhapokha mukadina batani.

faq.q: Ali ndi mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Ayi. Ichi ndi chithunzi chomwe mumayang'ana limodzi pa sikirini. Chithunzi chomwe mumakonda kapena positikhadi patebulo chimachita chimodzimodzi.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndifunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa intaneti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

color-wash.name: Kutsuka mtundu
color-wash.seoTitle: Kutsuka Mtundu: Mtundu Wofewa Pamwamba pa Tsamba
color-wash.h1: Kutsuka Mtundu: Penta Mtundu Wofewa Pamwamba pa Tsamba
color-wash.description: Burashi lofewa limapenta mizere yayikulu, yowonekera ya mtundu pa tsamba limodzi, mu mitundu inayi ndi kukula kwa burashi kawiri. Palibe mapeto, palibe mfundo ndipo palibe wotchi. Ndi kwaulere kusewera, popanda akaunti.
color-wash.short: Penta mizere yofewa ya mtundu pa tsamba, mwa liwiro lanu.
color-wash.intro: Tsamba limodzi ndi burashi limodzi lofewa. Sankhani mtundu ndi kukula kwa burashi, kenako kokerani pa tsamba kuti mupange mzere wa mtundu. Tsambali lilibe mapeto: palibe chomaliza, palibe chithunzi choti chikhale cholondola ndipo palibe mfundo. Pangani mizere yambiri momwe mukufunira, kapena ikani burashi pansi ndipo ingoyang'anani. Tsamba latsopano limachotsa zonse, ndipo Bwezerani kumabwezeretsa zomwe zinalipo.
howTo: Sankhani mtundu. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi dzina lake lolembedwa.
Sankhani Lalikulu kapena Lalikulu kwambiri. Lalikulu kwambiri limaphimba gawo lalikulu la tsamba ndi sitiroko iliyonse.
Kokerani pa tsamba ndi chala, mbewa kapena cholembera kuti mupange mzere wa mtundu.
Kapena gwiritsani ntchito makiyi a mivi kusuntha mphete ya burashi, ndi Space kuti muike burashi pansi kapena kuikweza.
Dinani "Tsamba latsopano" kuti muchotse tsamba, kenako "Bwezerani" ngati mukufuna kubwezeretsa mizere.
tips: Lolani munthu winayo asankhe mtundu wa mzere wotsatira, ndipo kambiranani za mitundu pamene ikukhala pa tsamba.
Lalikulu kwambiri ndilosavuta kuwongolera ngati dzanja likunjenjemera, chifukwa burashi sifunikira kukhala lolondola kwenikweni.
Palibe njira yolondola yojambulira. Lekani nthawi iliyonse mukafuna, kapena dinani "Thetsani kaye".

faq.q: Kodi pali mapeto, mfundo kapena wotchi?
faq.a: Ayi. Tsambali lilibe mapeto. Palibe chomalizidwa, chowerengedwa, choyezedwa nthawi kapena choperekedwa mfundo, ndipo palibe uthenga umene umakufunsani kuchita zina.

faq.q: Kodi tsambali limasungidwa kapena kutumizidwa?
faq.a: Ayi. Palibe chimene chimasungidwa, kusindikizidwa kapena kutumizidwa kulikonse. Mizere imakhalabe pa tsambali mpaka mutalichoka.

faq.q: Kodi ndingagwiritse ntchito popanda mbewa kapena sikirini yokhudza?
faq.a: Inde. Tsamba likakhala ndi chidwi, makiyi a mivi amasuntha mphete ya burashi, ndipo makiyi a Space amaika burashi pansi kapena kuikweza. Sikirini imati "Burashi pansi" kapena "Burashi pamwamba" nthawi iliyonse.

faq.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa pepala?
faq.a: Ayi. Penta yamadzi pa pepala ndi lingaliro lomwelo, burashi lonyowa ndi mtundu umodzi panthawi, kotero ndi ntchito yosiyana yoyesera patebulo.

faq.q: Mitundu yake ndi yotani?
faq.a: Yellow, lalanje, lobiriwira ndi lofiirira, mitundu inayi yomweyi yomwe imagwiritsidwa ntchito m'masewera athu ena a zithunzi. Mtundu uliwonse uli ndi dzina lolembedwa, ndipo dzinalo limaonekera pafupi ndi chosankhacho.

faq.q: Kodi ndi kwaulere, ndipo ndifunika kulembetsa?
faq.a: Inde, ndi kwaulere, ndipo palibe akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Imagwira ntchito pa msakatuli wa pa intaneti pa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.
